Train 72 justice actors on child and adolescent friendly procedures among rule of law and judicial actors in target districts and provinces to be able to better address the needs of violated neglected and abused children

64895 people received information on rights and legal services through awarenessraising meetings legal assistance fairs and civic education campaigns. The project supported access to justice services for vulnerable childrenparticularly girlsprovided by police prosecutors courts and legal aid providers resulting in 647 children benefiting from legal aid. The project also supported a 40 per cent increase in knowledge on child and adolescentfriendly procedures among 97 judicial actors serving the needs of violated neglected and abused children.
